records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Enterprise operating revenues increased $308.8 million, approximately 27%, in the third quarter of 2021 compared to the same quarter in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •a $190.2 million increase in Logistics segment revenues (excluding fuel surcharge) driven by increased revenue per order and volume growth;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •a $24.2 million increase in Truckload segment revenues (excluding fuel surcharge) resulting from improved revenue per truck per week, partially offset by lower volumes due to driver capacity constraints.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating expenses tend to be higher in the winter months, primarily due to colder weather, which causes higher maintenance expense and higher fuel consumption from increased idle time.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Enterprise net income increased $65.5 million, approximately 147%, in the third quarter of 2021 compared to the same quarter in 2020, primarily due to a $90.4 million increase in income from operations, partially offset by the corresponding increase in income taxes.
